title: Kenyan Garlic Herb Chicken
community: Popular in urban Kenyan households and restaurants
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Garlic Herb Chicken — whole chicken pieces marinated in a generous blend of fresh garlic, lemon, olive oil, coriander, thyme, and paprika, then grilled or roasted until deeply golden and fragrant. Simple, elegant, and universally loved.
longDesc: Garlic herb chicken is the Kenyan kitchen at its most generous — no complicated technique, just great ingredients treated with care. A robust garlic and herb marinade, plenty of lemon, and a hot grill or oven produces chicken with a deeply golden exterior, fragrant herb-infused skin, and tender, juicy meat that needs no sauce to be completely satisfying.
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil or vegetable oil
1 tbsp fresh thyme — or 1 tsp dried
steps: Score the chicken pieces 2—3 times to the bone.
Mix garlic, ginger, lemon juice, oil, coriander, thyme, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper into a marinade.
Coat the chicken thoroughly, ensuring the marinade gets into the scored cuts.
Marinate for at least 1 hour — overnight gives the best result.
Grill method: cook over medium charcoal or gas for 12—15 minutes per side, turning once, until deeply golden and cooked through.
Oven method: roast at 200°C for 30—35 minutes until golden and the juices run clear.
chefTips: Scoring is essential — without it the marinade only flavours the surface.
Do not rush the marinade — the garlic and lemon need time to penetrate.
Baste with the remaining marinade (bring to a boil first) during the last 5 minutes for a beautiful glaze.
commonMistakes: Cooking over very high heat — burns the garlic coating before the inside is done.

faqs.q: Can I use a whole chicken?
faqs.a: Yes — spatchcock (butterfly) the chicken for even cooking. Roast at 200°C for 45—55 minutes or grill for 35—40 minutes over medium heat.

cookingScience: Lemon juice in the marinade begins denaturing surface proteins and carries the fat-soluble aromatics from the garlic and herbs into the chicken flesh. Oil in the marinade acts as a vehicle for the fat-soluble flavour compounds, distributing them evenly.
sustainabilityTips: This recipe works beautifully with a whole chicken — more economical and less waste than pre-cut pieces.
reheating: Reheat in oven at 180°C for 10 minutes.
healthBenefits: Garlic provides allicin — a natural antimicrobial compound.
Herbs add antioxidants and flavour without extra calories.
culturalNote: Garlic herb chicken reflects the evolution of Kenyan home cooking — drawing on classic Kenyan ingredients (garlic, coriander, lemon) while embracing fresh herb preparations that have become popular in urban Kenyan kitchens.
regionalVariations: Rosemary garlic chicken — a Nairobi restaurant favourite.
